{"action":"shell","command":"python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, io
p='/testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s=open(p).read()
old_status='**Status**: Draft (updated 2026-10-17 for milestone 2 + round-2 clarification)'
new_status='**Status**: Draft (updated 2026-10-17 for milestone 2 + round-2 clarification; updated 2026-10-17 for milestone 3 R07/R08 entry expiry)'
assert old_status in s
s=s.replace(old_status,new_status)
# extend Input block
old_in='state)."'
new_in=('state). Milestone 3 (retaining R01-R06): R07 constructor accepts '
'timer=None (default time.monotonic); put adds ttl=None, where None means no '
'expiration and a finite nonnegative int/float excluding bool sets expiry at '
'timer()+ttl; invalid TTL raises ValueError before any mutation; TTL zero is '
'immediately expired; at the exact expiry boundary a key is expired. R08 '
'expired entries are removed before get, put, len, resize, and invalidation, '
'without touching the recency of surviving entries; overwriting an entry '
'replaces its prior expiry; tag invalidation counts only live entries; a '
'missing/expired get raises KeyError; existing callers without timer/ttl '
'retain previous behavior."')
assert old_in in s
s=s.replace(old_in,new_in,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok status+input')
PYEOF"}
